affectedComponentIds.description: IDs of existing components that need modification. Empty if no changes are required or no existing model is present.

addComponents.description: True if any new components need to be created, or - for initial generation - if a new UI should be generated from scratch.

removeComponentIds.description: IDs of components that should be removed entirely or replaced/split. Must be disjoint from affectedComponentIds.

formalAnalysis.description: Structured technical breakdown of the requested UI changes (fields, layout, validation, groupings, etc.) that downstream generation stages will use as the source-of-truth description of what to build. Should be empty when no generation/changes are required.

commentary.description: User-facing conversational reply shown DIRECTLY to the user. When no generation is required this should answer their question or ask for clarification. When generation is required this should be a short friendly acknowledgement of what is being built.
